data.current_description:
Composite factor scorecard. Research signal, not investment advice.

Composite factor scorecard (0-100) for one company, fusing quality (Piotroski F-Score, Altman Z, Sloan accruals), value (owner-earnings DCF margin of safety), insider conviction (Form 4 buying), institutional positioning (13F holder change) and short sentiment (FINRA short volume), with per-factor scores, coverage, cross-dataset metrics and data-quality flags. Weights are caller-overridable. Research signal, not investment advice.
data.summary_suggestion: Calculate composite research signal scorecard for company
data.description_suggestion: Generates a composite factor scorecard (0-100) for one US public company, fusing multiple research signals: quality metrics (Piotroski F-Score, Altman Z-Score, Sloan accruals), value metrics (owner-earnings DCF margin of safety), insider conviction (Form 4 buying activity), institutional positioning (13F holder changes), and short sentiment (FINRA short volume). Returns per-factor scores, data coverage, cross-dataset metrics, and quality flags. Factor weights are caller-overridable via parameters. This is a research signal for fundamental analysis, not investment advice.
